disposition.rationale: Six of the eight published formats are carried, one each; 3 and 4 are not, and 5 to 8 are reduced. Every uppercase word in a form joins the set is_operand_atom rejects, so TRUE, FALSE, SELF, NULL, NULLS, ADDRESS OF and LENGTH OF break what they describe. Format 4's only senders are TRUE and FALSE. Format 3's are ON and OFF: OFF breaks the same way, measured; ON is already reserved by other rows, so SET SW TO ON on a UPSI mnemonic is MECOB0102 today while SET SW TO OFF is accepted. The dropped form wrote ON.
